༄༅/ /snying gtam so lnga pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snying gtam so lnga pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gang sngon tshogs gnyis goms pa mthar phyin zhing*// mtha' yas 'gro la brtse ba'i khur bsnams nas// rgyal kun phrin las dbang por mnga' gsol ba// rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu// mi shes 'khrul ba'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams// nyon mongs rlung gis dbang med bdas pa'i mthus// ji bzhin dge ba'i lam dang kha ma reg /ji ltar mtsho chen 'jing gi rus sbal gyis// gnya' shing bu gar mgrin chud ji bzhin du// bsod nams stobs kyis da lta dal 'byor lus// mtshan ldan rnyed tshe chud mi zos pa yi// snying po len pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// mi lus thob kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang*// mjal bar dka' zhing sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i// sgra yang 'jig rten khams 'dir thos dka' na// des gsungs dam chos spyod pa dbang yod tshe// 'bad pas bsgrub pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rnyed dka' mtshan ldan bla ma dang mjal tshe// mnyes pa gsum gyis rab tu gus bsten nas// des gsungs man ngag bdud rtsi'i ro mchog rnams// gces par 'dzin pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba bslab pa'i gzhi// mchog gsum skyabs kyi gtso bor khas blangs nas// de yi bslab bya phra rags ma lus pa// srog ltar 'dzin pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// chos kun rtsa ba byams dang snying rje dang*// bdag las gzhan gces smon 'jug sdom pa'i tshogs// ji ltar mig dang snying ltar rab gces par// brtan por 'chang ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// byang chub thob byed rdo rje theg pa'i lam// smin grol lam gyi snying po gang gsungs pa// dus kun sdom gsum gnas 'gyur yar ldan du// rab tu 'bad pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la// dam tshig gces par bsrung ba'i gus 'dud dang*// rtsa ltung yan lag bcas pa gang gsungs pa// nyams len rtsa ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// yon tan kun gzhi bag yod yin pa'i phyir// rnam g.yeng spangs nas dben pa'i sa phyogs su// ri dwags smas ma ji bzhin sbas pa'i tshul// gcig pur gnas pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// de yang bag med spyad na ri dwags tshogs// dben par gnas kyang dgos pa med pa ltar// brtson 'grus long med drag pos dran bskul gyis// rnam g.yeng spong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// gang du gnas shing su dang 'grogs na yang*// khyad du mi gsod bre mo'i gtam mi smra// gzhan sems sna khrid byas kyang dgos pa med// drang por gnas pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// gzhan lugs grub mtha'i mtha' la spong len dang*// dgag sgrub de rjes 'brang ba kun spangs nas// btang snyoms bzhag ste rang la bla ma yis// gang gsungs nyams blangs kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang gi nyams myong nang nas ma skyes shing*// lta ba'i phu thag bsgoms pas ma bcad na// thal phyir dpe ltas lam gyis der mi mthong*// rtag tu sgom pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// gcig shes kun grol phyag rgya che med na// bka' bcu rab 'byams ming gis yid tshims te// 'chi tshe sbrul gyi pags pa dor ba ltar// tha mal 'gyod pa'i ngang du 'gro dgos pas// gnas lugs sgom pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// chen po btsun po phyug po dpa' bo sogs// dregs ldan kun kyang mthar thug bar do 'grims// che dregs de kos ngan lang mi grol bas// dam chos spyod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// bag med chang dang 'dod log la sogs pa// dam pas khrel zhing tshul khrims 'chal ba'i rgyu// rtag tu bag dang ldan pa'i srung sems kyi// ngo tsha skyes pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// mchongs rgyug lus kyi rol rtsed ji snyed pa'ang*// khams lus gnod cing gzhan khrel smra ba'i rgyu// rtag tu gcom bskyung dul bar gnas la bslab// lus kyi bag yod kho bo'i snying gtam yin// ngag gi long gtam shags dang ku re sogs// 'chal po 'tshogs pa'i dbus su nyams dga' ba// shes ldan khrel zhing nyes pa kun gyi gzhi// ngag tshig dul ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// lus ngag dul yang rang sems ma dul na// ji ltar sbrul dang byi la'i rnam thar bzhin// kha 'jam gting rtsub nyon mongs khong du gsog

/rang sems 'dul ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// sems nyid chu dwangs rnam rtog rnyog mas lhad// dran shes 'gyu ba'i rlung gis de dkrugs pas// sbar lag ma byed dug nad dug gis zin// 'dzin med bslab pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// sems dang sems byung spos dang du ba bzhin// gcig las gcig byung de med de mi 'byung*// de phyir rang rang ngo bos stong pa la// gnyen po mi dgos kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang sems gdod nas spros dang bral ba la// spros bcas dran rtsis rtsab tsub mang mi dgos// blo 'das gang shar 'dzin med yengs med ngang*// shar grol dus mnyam kho ba'i snying gtam yin// tshogs drug snang ba so sor mi dgag cing*// der 'dzin med par de rjes mi 'brang bar// gang ltar snang ba de nyid sems kyi gshis// babs su grol ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// bsgom du med snyam pa yang rnam rtog la// bsgom du yod sems pa yang rnam rtog yin// de phyir sgom dang mi sgom mi sems par// lhug par 'jog pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// 'di yin 'di min rtsis gdab med pa la// rtog pa gang shar kha yan mi gtong zhing*// de la bcos slad dgag sgrub mi byed par| |so mar skyong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// gnyis 'dzin re dogs spang blang mi byed par// lus ngag bya ba spros bral ngang nas spyod// bcos ma'i 'gyu ba dran rtog dbyings su thim| |rang thang 'jog pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang sems ngo bo brtan pa ma thob par// bcos ma'i sgom pa rnal 'byor bcu gnyis sogs// gang ltar btags kyang don la gol ba'i phyir// gnyug ma skyong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// sems nyid dul na nga yir 'dzin rtsa bral// 'ga' zhig sems nyid rtogs par khas blangs nas// grub chen la sogs snying la sbar snying 'tham// de la zhen log kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang sems rtogs na slob ma ngang gis 'du// grong yul gseb du gzhog slong bya mi dgos// sems can thabs kyis bslu ba dgos pa chung*// 'khor tshogs mi bsdu kho bo'i snying gtam yin// nor rdzas bya ba gtong bar khas blangs nas// gzhan las bslang ba'i nor gyis 'khor 'bangs sdud// legs bshad thab ka 'du long dag la re// de 'dra spong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// sbyin pa sbyin pos gtong zhing len pos len// 'dod chung med pa'i bsod snyoms byed do lo// gzhan nor thabs kyis 'phrog cing gzhog slong byed// yi mug de spong kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang nyams spang rtogs yon tan ci shar yang*// 'chor chas gzhan ngom mi byed khong du sbed// gzhan pa'i yon tan bdag las dma' rnams la'ang*// yi rang sgom pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// 'gro la brtse sems ngang gis mi 'dor zhing*// rang bstod spangs shing gzhan skyon 'tshang mi 'bru| |gang yang 'dzin med blo bral phyam yangs su// btang snyoms byed pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang la mkho ba'i yo byad ji snyed la'ang*// tshe 'dir g.yar po tsam las zhen chags bral// 'khor 'bangs grogs dang nor rdzas rang lus bcas// mi rtag dgos med kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rang byas las la rang bsam btang nas kyang*| |sdig pas gang gos 'phral du bshags shing sdoms// dge ba gang byas bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa// nyin mtshan kun byed kho bo'i snying gtam yin// mdor na tshe 'dir bya ba gang byed rnams// ngo lkog gzhan mgo skor la mi sems shing*// dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs kyis ma khrel bar// lag len yongs bsdams kho bo'i snying gtam yin// de ltar snying gtam sum cu rtsa lnga 'di// gzhan skyon brjod pa'i khyad gsod ma yin zhing*// gzur gnas spong pa'i g.yo dang sgyu min mod// mnga' ris chos mdzad ma yi gsung gi ngor// rang gi nyams len zhe 'dod phugs bcug pa// kha zhe med par bris 'di 'bri gung pa// chos kyi grags pas mgyogs bris dge legs 'phel// thar 'dod yod na lam 'dir bsten par rigs| |dmyal ba'i tshogs dpon mdzad la smon pa rnams// snying gtam 'di kun rma dang dug lta bu// 'gyur gyi dgongs mdzod shes ldan yod na ko//
